newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, World Bank sign $102 mln rebuilding loan.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, World Bank sign $102 mln rebuilding loan.

text.p: Croatia and the World Bank signed an agreement for a $102 million loan for mine clearing and to rebuild a war damaged transport network, Croatian radio reported on Thursday.
It said the loan was signed in Washington on Wednesday. The funds will also cover other infrastructure reconstruction projects of mutual interest to Croatia and neighbouring Bosnia.

State news agency HINA quoted the bank's director for Europe, Jean-Michel Severino, as saying the World Bank was also preparing several new loans and planned to open an office in Croatia soon. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
